title: Mission Control · Agent Ops
caption: Every run, every dollar, every failure · one screen
buildPrompt: the agent-ops command center: run volume, spend, p50 latency and error rate across every agent in the tree, plus the live feed of runs — all Langfuse-backed, nothing static — and one week grid of what is scheduled to run, read from ops.schedule through a registered query, monochrome and annotated with an occurrence count rather than a cost

signals.detail: Open the trace before the next schedule fires — a failing agent on a cron repeats its failure on a cron.
signals.pending: No failed runs in this window.

signals.lead: {value} of model spend in this window
signals.detail: The runner refuses to start a run once the hard monthly cap is hit, and says so in the error hint.
signals.pending: No spend recorded yet — the runner writes cost to Langfuse on its first run.

signals.lead: Mission Control is the only center that is real today
signals.detail: The other five name the agent that owes them rows; they fill in as those agents start running, not before.

widgets.title: This morning, run by agents
widgets.subtitle: Every row is a Langfuse trace
widgets.emptyState: No runs yet — the feed fills the moment you press ▶ Run now in any drawer.

widgets.title: Runs, by thread
widgets.subtitle: A thread is the unit of work · a run is a thread with an agent on the other end
widgets.emptyState: No runs yet, so no thread has anything to show — the mailbox writes threads as agents start answering.
widgets.unthreadedState: Runs in this window that belong to no thread: {value}. A run only carries a thread once the runner records one, so this is the writer being unwired — not your threads being quiet.

widgets.title: Last runs
widgets.subtitle: Click a row to peek inside

widgets.title: The week ahead
widgets.subtitle: Every schedule that fires, by the thread it addresses
widgets.emptyState: No schedules yet — the coordinator writes ops.schedule when an agent is first put on a clock, and the library half cannot be written at all until an agent's schedule: carries a zone and its two policies.
widgets.unplaceableState: Schedules with no occurrence computed for this week, so none of them can be placed on a day: {value}. The coordinator owns the clock and has never run — this is the scheduler being unwired, not a quiet week.
widgets.projectionState: Occurrences on this grid: {value}. No spend is projected beside them: no run has ever completed, so there is nothing to average and a per-occurrence figure would be invented.

footer.detail: Your delivery ops, running like this · agents doing the work, you approving it.
